title: Goan Filmmaker Aditya Suhas Jambhale honoured at the Closing Ceremony of 57th IFFI
body_text:
Posted On: 28 NOV 2026 8:47PM by PIB Mumbai Release ID: 2343237 Views: 76 A A Print Share X Facebook Instagram WhatsApp Copy Article Link
Read in: English Marathi हिन्दी Urdu
Goa, 28 November, 2026 Goan filmmaker Aditya Suhas Jambhale was felicitated by the Chief Minister of Goa, Dr. Pramod Sawant, at the star-studded Closing Ceremony of the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI), held in Goa today. The honour recognizes his remarkable creative journey, cinematic excellence and his contribution to the ever-evolving landscape of Indian cinema. A three-time National Film Award winner, Aditya Suhas Jambhale has also earned acclaim at prestigious platforms such as the Filmfare Awards, IIFA Awards and Zee Cine Awards for his exceptional contribution to Indian cinema. His remarkable journey from theatre to the national film industry reflects a deep commitment to the art of storytelling, backed by extraordinary talent, perseverance and creative excellence. Through his body of work, he has made a significant contribution to the rich and diverse landscape of Indian cinema, inspiring generations of artists and strengthening the cultural fabric of the nation's film industry. Aditya Suhas Jambhale’s impressive record of achievement at the National Film Awards comprises films across both feature and non-feature categories. His Hindi feature film ‘Article 370’ won the Best Feature Film award at the 72nd National Film Awards for 2024. Earlier, his Marathi short film ‘Aaba Aiktaay Naa?’ received the Rajat Kamal for Best Direction in the Non-Feature Film category at the 64th National Film Awards in 2017, while another Marathi short film ‘Kharvas’ won the Rajat Kamal for Best Short Fiction Film at the 66th National Film Awards for 2018. These accolades underscore his versatility as a filmmaker and his ability to create compelling cinema across formats and genres. 🎬 Honouring cinematic excellence at #IFFI2026!

Three-time National Film Award-winning Goan filmmaker Aditya Suhas Jambhale was felicitated by Goa Chief Minister Dr. Pramod Sawant at the star-studded Closing Ceremony of the 57th IFFI, recognising his remarkable creative journey and outstanding contribution to Indian cinema.

From his journey in theatre to earning national acclaim, Jambhale has demonstrated his versatility through award-winning films such as ‘Article 370’, ‘Aaba Aiktaay Naa?’ and ‘Kharvas’. 

His achievements across feature and non-feature cinema reflect his exceptional talent, perseverance and deep commitment to storytelling.
